input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。
CURRENT SCENE:
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P137] 而是想【^】孟子有很好的教育
  proposed by the AI checker: 而是想[+让]孟子有很好的教育 (想 needs 让 before another subject and verb)
  her past correction (other): 教育做完以后[+，]孟子考虑
  her past correction (collocation_selection): [教育做完→学完]以后孟子考虑
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟母一直想[+让]她的孩子受到良好的教育 — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P138] 而是想孟子【有】很好的教育
  proposed by the AI checker: 而是想孟子[有→接受]很好的教育 (one normally 接受 good education)
  proposed by the correction model: 而是想孟子[有→受到]很好的教育
  her past correction (laoshi_negative_repetition): 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  her past correction (other): 教育做完以后[+，]孟子考虑
  her past correction (collocation_selection): [教育做完→学完]以后孟子考虑
  rule card laoshi_negative_repetition: 老是 means “always” and is used for something negative or to complain; for a neutral or positive repeated action, use 一直 or 常常 instead. Not an error: Use 老是 when the repeated action is negative or the speaker is complaining about it. Do not flag it merely because it means “always.”
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.

[P139] 他们搬【家】到有很多学校的城市
  proposed by the correction model: 他们搬[-家]到有很多学校的城市
  her past correction (le_completed): 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction (specific_noun_choice): 他们搬家每次学到了[比较多→很多知识]
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P140] 他们搬家到【^】有很多学校的城市
  proposed by the correction model: 他们搬家到[+了]有很多学校的城市
  her past correction (le_completed): 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction (specific_noun_choice): 他们搬家每次学到了[比较多→很多知识]
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P141] 【他难怪】抱怨
  proposed by the AI checker: [他难怪→难怪他]抱怨 (难怪 should come before the subject)
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 他[看得很麻烦的事情→看到很麻烦的情况]
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 因为他这么[无→无聊] — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction (haide_harmful_result): ⟦害得他不高兴⟧ — her note: 害得 + harmful result, “不高兴” is not that “harmful”
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”

places.reason: 想 needs 让 before another subject and action.
受到良好的教育 is the natural collocation.
搬家到 a city is acceptable.
The move is a completed narrative action.
The flagged text is not in the current scene; 孟子一直抱怨 is acceptable.
